citations.assessment: The eulogy discussion gives bar Kipok. The parallel in Yevamot writes bar Kipof. The Kipoz reading is separately attributed to Arukh.
The entry-local cross-pointer names the two people in the mourning account. The Bar Kipok heading is a reciprocal pointer.

holds.reason: The specific lexicon passage and edition with Kipoz remain open. The separately indexed animal-word entry and both Bavli witnesses do not verify this attributed personal-name form.
Rav Ashi directly questions him, but formal pupilhood is Heilprin’s further characterization. The direct text does not state it.
